description: Get chart-ready data for Plotly or any charting library. Report charts require auth. Newsletter charts (expert_network, topic_heatmap, engagement_funnel, geo_coverage, keyword_trends, article_bridge, expert_leaderboard, timeline) are free.

category.description: Category filter — applies to category_breakdown, top_metrics, coverage, export_table

limit.description: Max rows (default 20, max 200). For topic_heatmap/keyword_trends: top N keywords.

silo.description: Report slug filter (e.g. "africa-streaming-2026"). Required for export_table. Omit for all active silos on other chart types.

name: get_chart_data

chart_type.description: The chart type that was rendered.
